chapter: Struttin' Time, chronology and Chicago singers
title: Mattie Hite, the kind singer who sent her to New York
summary: A tall, dark, heavy-voiced woman who tried to help the youngster move up.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Oh, what a voice. She had a heavy voice. Girl, you ain't got no business here. You belong in New Y ork. Go on to New York. And could she sing. She could sing a while, Chris.

She was a tall, dark brown skinned girl, very full of life and very kind, because she, you know, being a youngster, me, there -- she was trying to help me. She was trying to help me go and better my condition, going up a little higher, move on up a little higher.
